TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Arum. m.]
Stitching and burning on tongue several hours.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Arum. m.]
Stinging in mouth as with a hundred needles.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Arum. m.]
Vomiting of blood.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Arum. m.]
Hoarseness.
Blood-spitting.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Arum. m.]
During sleep face red.
